title: Scaling a correlated sign-vector characteristic function
statement: Let $\rho\in[-1,1]$, let $a\in\mathbb R$, and let $t=(t_1,t_2)\in\mathbb R^2$. The characteristic function of the correlated sign-vector measure at $at$ equals the characteristic function at $a$ of the real projection $s_1t_1+s_2t_2$ under the correlated sign-pair distribution.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ is a point of the real correlation plane
